walgreens.name: Walgreens
walgreens.description: Walgreens is an American pharmacy store chain headquartered in Deerfield, Illinois. It is the second largest pharmacy chain in the U.S., offering pharmacy and photo services across thousands of stores.

wpp-plc.name: WPP plc
wpp-plc.description: WPP plc is a British multinational holding company specializing in communications, advertising, public relations, technology, and commerce. Headquartered in London, it is the world's largest advertising company as of 2023 and owns numerous advertising and media agencies including Ogilvy and EssenceMediacom.

webuild.name: Webuild
webuild.description: Webuild S.p.A. is an Italian industrial group specializing in construction and civil engineering. Founded in 2014 through the merger of Salini and Impregilo, it is one of the largest Italian construction groups. The company operates in the construction industry.

whole-foods-market.name: Whole Foods Market
whole-foods-market.description: Whole Foods Market, Inc. is an American multinational supermarket chain headquartered in Austin, Texas. It sells whole food products free from hydrogenated fats and artificial additives and is a USDA Certified Organic grocer in the US. The company operates in the food industry.

western-digital.name: Western Digital
western-digital.description: Western Digital Corporation, known as WD, is an American data storage company headquartered in San Jose, California. Established in 1970, it is one of the world's largest manufacturers of hard disk drives (HDDs).

wsp-global.name: WSP Global
wsp-global.description: WSP is a Canadian engineering and professional services consulting firm providing technical and advisory services for built and natural environment projects. It is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and part of major Canadian stock indices.

wistron.name: Wistron
wistron.description: Wistron Corporation is a Taiwan-based electronics manufacturer formerly part of Acer Inc. It designs and manufactures products such as computers, servers, storage, LCD TVs, handheld devices, and medical equipment for other companies to sell under their brands.

willis-towers-watson.name: Willis Towers Watson
willis-towers-watson.description: Willis Towers Watson plc is a British-American multinational company providing advisory, broking, and solutions services. Its operations include commercial insurance brokerage, risk advisory, employee benefits consulting, retirement and actuarial services, and investment advice for pension funds and institutional investors.

waste-management-inc.name: Waste Management, Inc
waste-management-inc.description: Waste Management, Inc., doing business as WM, is an American waste management company operating in North America. Founded in 1968, it is headquartered in the Bank of America Tower in Houston, Texas.

ww-international.name: WW International
ww-international.description: WW International, Inc., formerly Weight Watchers International, Inc., is a global company headquartered in the U.S. offering weight loss, fitness, and mindset services. Founded in 1963, it provides programs online, via coaching, and through in-person meetings.

workday-inc.name: Workday, Inc.
workday-inc.description: Workday, Inc. is an American cloud-based software provider specializing in financial management, human capital management, and student information systems. Founded by former PeopleSoft executives David Duffield and Aneel Bhusri after Oracle acquired PeopleSoft in 2005, the company operates in the software industry.

wienerberger.name: Wienerberger
wienerberger.description: Wienerberger AG is an Austrian company specializing in building solutions and infrastructure systems. It is Europe's leading manufacturer of roof tiles and the world's largest producer of bricks.

worldline.name: Worldline
worldline.industry: Data processing, hosting and related activities
worldline.description: Worldline SA is a French payment processing company founded in 1972. It operates in data processing, hosting, and related activities. In 2024, the company reported revenue of €4.63 billion.

wincanton-plc.name: Wincanton plc
wincanton-plc.description: Wincanton plc is a British logistics provider originally focused on milk haulage. It offers transport, logistics services, automated warehouses, and supply chain management. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by GXO Logistics in April 2024.

weyerhaeuser.name: Weyerhaeuser
weyerhaeuser.description: The Weyerhaeuser Company is an American timberland company that owns approximately 10.4 million acres of timberlands in the U.S. and manages an additional 14 million acres in Canada under long-term licenses. It has manufactured wood products for over a century and operates as a real estate investment trust (REIT).

weir-group.name: Weir Group
weir-group.description: Weir plc is a Scottish multinational engineering company headquartered in Glasgow. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index. The company operates in the mining sector.

wanhua-chemical-group-co-ltd.name: Wanhua Chemical Group Co., Ltd.
wanhua-chemical-group-co-ltd.description: Wanhua Chemical Group Co., Ltd., also known as Wanhua Chemical, is a Chinese listed company in the chemical industry. It was formerly known as Yantai Wanhua Polyurethane. The company is based in China and operates in the chemical sector.

western-union.name: Western Union
western-union.description: The Western Union Company is an American multinational financial services corporation headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It specializes in financial services and operates globally.

winbond.name: Winbond
winbond.description: Winbond Electronics Corporation is a Taiwan-based semiconductor company founded in 1987. It produces various integrated circuits including dynamic and static random-access memory, serial flash, microcontrollers, and Super I/O chips.

waters-corporation.name: Waters Corporation
waters-corporation.industry: Manufacturing of scientific and technical instrumentation
waters-corporation.description: Waters Corporation is an American company headquartered in Milford, Massachusetts. It provides analytical instruments and software used for chromatography, mass spectrometry, laboratory informatics, and rheometry. Its products serve the life sciences, materials, and food industries.

west-fraser-timber.name: West Fraser Timber
west-fraser-timber.description: West Fraser Timber Co. Ltd. is a Canadian forestry company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. It produces various wood products including lumber, plywood, and pulp. The company is a member of the Forest Products Association of Canada.

wix-com.name: Wix.com
wix-com.description: Wix.com Ltd. is an Israeli software company that provides cloud-based web development services. It offers tools for creating HTML5 websites using online drag-and-drop editing. The company has headquarters in Israel and offices worldwide, including the United States and several other countries.

wirecard.name: Wirecard
wirecard.description: Wirecard AG was a German payment processor and financial services provider. It offered electronic payment transaction services, risk management, and issued physical and virtual cards. The company was listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and was part of the DAX index from 2018 to 2020 before becoming insolvent.

warner-music-group.name: Warner Music Group
warner-music-group.description: Warner Music Group Corp. is an American multinational entertainment and record label conglomerate headquartered in New York City. It is one of the Big Four recording companies and ranks third in the global music industry.

wolfspeed.name: Wolfspeed
wolfspeed.description: Wolfspeed, Inc. is an American developer and manufacturer of wide-bandgap semiconductors, focusing on silicon carbide materials and devices for power applications. The company was formerly known as Cree, Inc. It serves sectors such as transportation, power supplies, and wireless systems.

westlake-corporation.name: Westlake Corporation
westlake-corporation.description: Westlake Corporation is an international manufacturer and supplier of petrochemicals, polymers, and fabricated building products based in the United States. Founded in 1986, it is the largest producer of low-density polyethylene in the US. The company operates in Olefins and Vinyls segments with integrated vinyl production.

wsfs-bank.name: WSFS Bank
wsfs-bank.description: WSFS Financial Corporation is a financial services company headquartered in Delaware and the Philadelphia area. Its main subsidiary, WSFS Bank, operates 115 offices across several US states and offers commercial and retail banking, treasury management, and wealth management services.

waskita-karya.name: Waskita Karya
waskita-karya.description: PT Waskita Karya (Persero) Tbk, known as Waskita Karya, is an Indonesian state-owned construction company based in Cawang, Jakarta. It was formed in 1961 through the nationalization of the Indonesian branch of VolkerWessels. The company specializes in commercial and residential building contracts.

wallbox.name: Wallbox
wallbox.description: Wallbox is a Spanish company that designs, manufactures, and distributes smart electric vehicle charging and energy management technologies. It operates in the automotive and electric vehicle sector.

wildbrain.name: WildBrain
wildbrain.description: WildBrain Ltd. is a Canadian media, animation studio, production, and brand licensing company. It owns the largest independent library of children's television programming, including assets from acquisitions like Cookie Jar Group and distribution rights to Jay Ward Productions.

weifa.name: Weifa
weifa.description: Weifa is a Norwegian pharmaceutical company headquartered in Oslo with production facilities in Kragerø Municipality. It operates in the pharmaceutical industry in Norway.

wingtech-technology.name: Wingtech Technology
wingtech-technology.description: Wingtech Technology is a Chinese partially state-owned semiconductor and communications product integration company based in Jiaxing, Zhejiang. It has been publicly traded on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 2015 and is partly owned by Luxshare.

walmart-de-mexico-y-centroamerica.name: Walmart de México y Centroamérica
walmart-de-mexico-y-centroamerica.description: Walmart de México y Centroamérica, known as Walmex, is the Mexican and Central American division of Walmart. It is the largest Walmart division outside the U.S. and the largest retailer in Latin America, operating thousands of stores across Mexico and Central America.

warner-bros-discovery.name: Warner Bros. Discovery
warner-bros-discovery.description: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. was an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in New York City. It was formed in 2022 by merging Discovery, Inc. with WarnerMedia, a subsidiary of AT&T.

westgold-resources-limited.name: Westgold Resources Limited
westgold-resources-limited.description: Westgold Resources is a gold producer and explorer based in Perth, Western Australia. The company was founded in 1987 and operates in the gold mining sector.

weibo-corporation.name: Weibo Corporation
weibo-corporation.description: Weibo Corporation is a Chinese social network company based in Beijing, known for the microblogging website Sina Weibo.

wuhan-iron-and-steel-corporation.name: Wuhan Iron and Steel Corporation
wuhan-iron-and-steel-corporation.description: Wuhan Iron and Steel Corporation (WISCO) is a Chinese state-owned enterprise operating since 1958. It is based in Qingshan, Wuhan, Hubei, China, and operates in the iron and steel industry.

w-r-berkley.name: W. R. Berkley
w-r-berkley.description: W. R. Berkley Corporation is an American commercial lines property and casualty insurance holding company. It is organized in Delaware and based in Greenwich, Connecticut. The company operates in the insurance industry.

western-mining-company.name: Western Mining Company
western-mining-company.description: Western Mining Co., Ltd. is a major Chinese metal mining and smelting company headquartered in Xining, Qinghai Province. It explores, mines, processes, and sells non-ferrous and precious metals including copper, lead, zinc, iron, gold, and silver. It is one of China's largest producers of lead and zinc concentrates.

wilan.name: WiLAN
wilan.description: WiLAN is a technology development and intellectual property licensing company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. It licenses its own portfolio of patents and collaborates with other patent owners. WiLAN Labs conducts research and development in modern wireless communication methods.

wme-group.name: WME Group
wme-group.description: WME Group, LLC is an American holding company for talent and media agencies headquartered in Beverly Hills, California. Founded in 2009 after the merger of William Morris Agency and Endeavor Talent Agency, it represents artists across multiple entertainment sectors and owns major sports entertainment companies.

whsmith.name: WHSmith
whsmith.description: WH Smith plc is a British travel retailer operating in Europe, North America, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East. It mainly operates in airports, railway stations, hospitals, and motorway service stations, selling refreshments, books, and entertainment under brands like WHSmith and InMotion.

w-w-grainger.name: W. W. Grainger
w-w-grainger.description: W. W. Grainger, Inc. is an American industrial supply company founded in 1927 in Chicago. It serves over 4.5 million customers worldwide with products like motors, lighting, and safety supplies, mainly through business-to-business sales via branches and online channels.

wausau-paper.name: Wausau Paper
wausau-paper.description: Wausau Paper is an American pulp and paper company with manufacturing operations in Kentucky and Ohio, and a support facility in Wisconsin. It was acquired by SCA Tissue North America in 2016 and subsequently removed from the NYSE.

wpg-resources-ltd.name: WPG Resources Ltd
wpg-resources-ltd.description: WPG Resources was an Australian mining company focused on exploration, evaluation, and development of gold and coal projects in South Australia. The company specialized in mining activities within the region.

willdan-group.name: Willdan Group
willdan-group.description: Willdan Group, Inc. is an American company providing professional technical and consulting services to utilities, government agencies, and commercial firms. It operates offices in more than a dozen states, with key operations in California and New York.

weingarten-realty.name: Weingarten Realty
weingarten-realty.description: Weingarten Realty Investors was a real estate investment trust focused on shopping centers primarily in the Southern United States, often anchored by grocery stores. The company was acquired by Kimco Realty in August 2021.

wheaton-precious-metals.name: Wheaton Precious Metals
wheaton-precious-metals.description: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. is a Canadian multinational precious metals streaming company. It produces and sells large quantities of silver mined by other companies as a by-product of their main operations.

wh-group.name: WH Group
wh-group.description: WH Group is a Hong Kong-based multinational meat and food processing company. It operates businesses including hog raising, consumer meat products, flavoring products, and logistics. It is the largest meat producer in China.

wilmar-international.name: Wilmar International
wilmar-international.description: Wilmar International Limited is a Singaporean food processing and investment holding company founded in 1991. It is one of Asia's leading agribusiness groups and was ranked 211th in the Fortune Global 500 list in 2020.

wealthfront.name: Wealthfront
wealthfront.description: Wealthfront Corporation is an American financial services company based in Palo Alto, California, founded in 2008. It manages assets for more than 1.5 million clients.

walgreens-boots-alliance.name: Walgreens Boots Alliance
walgreens-boots-alliance.description: Walgreens Boots Alliance, Inc. was an American multinational holding company headquartered in Deerfield, Illinois. It was formed in 2014 after Walgreens acquired the remaining stake in Alliance Boots. In 2025, it was taken private by Sycamore Partners and split into five new companies.

wpx-energy.name: WPX Energy
wpx-energy.description: WPX Energy, Inc. was a hydrocarbon exploration company organized in Delaware and headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma. In 2021, it merged with Devon Energy.

westfield-group.name: Westfield Group
westfield-group.description: Westfield Group was an Australian shopping centre company from 1960 to 2014. It split into Scentre Group, operating Australian and New Zealand centres, and Westfield Corporation, which operated American and European centres until merging to form Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield.

wd-40-company.name: WD-40 Company
wd-40-company.description: The WD-40 Company is an American manufacturer of household and multi-use products based in San Diego, California. Its signature brand is WD-40, and it also produces other products such as 3-In-One Oil and Lava. The company was originally known as the Rocket Chemical Company.

wintrust-financial.name: Wintrust Financial
wintrust-financial.description: Wintrust is a financial holding company in the United States operating 15 chartered community banks in northern Illinois and southern Wisconsin. It is classified as a medium-sized banking institution and is the second largest banking company in Chicago.

washington-prime-group.name: Washington Prime Group
washington-prime-group.description: Washington Prime Group Inc. is an American real estate investment trust organized in Indiana with headquarters in Columbus, Ohio. It invests in shopping centers and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in June 2021.

wendel.name: Wendel
wendel.description: Wendel is a French investment company managed by Laurent Mignon and David Darmon. Since July 2018, Nicolas ver Hulst has been chairman of the supervisory board.

wendy-s-company.name: Wendy's Company
wendy-s-company.description: The Wendy's Company is an American fast food corporation and holding company for Wendy's and First Kitchen. It is headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, and its principal subsidiary is Wendy's International, the franchisor of Wendy's restaurants.

williams-sonoma-inc.name: Williams-Sonoma, Inc.
williams-sonoma-inc.description: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an American publicly traded consumer retail company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It sells kitchenware and home furnishings through stores, websites, and a gift registry, with brands including Williams Sonoma and Pottery Barn.

worthington-industries.name: Worthington Industries
worthington-industries.description: Worthington Enterprises, Inc. is an American industrial manufacturing company based in Columbus, Ohio. It operates two business segments: consumer products and building products, manufacturing pressure vessels and various retail products under several brand names.

wustenrot-wurttembergische.name: Wüstenrot & Württembergische
wustenrot-wurttembergische.description: Wüstenrot & Württembergische (W&W) is a German financial services company founded in 1999 and based in Stuttgart. It offers insurance, banking, and investment products, and became one of Germany's top 15 insurance groups after acquiring Karlsruher Versicherungsgruppe in 2005.

weber-stephen-products.name: Weber-Stephen Products
weber-stephen-products.description: Weber Inc. is an American company that manufactures charcoal, gas, and electric outdoor grills along with related accessories. It also owns restaurants and publishes cookbooks.

wuhan-iron-and-steel-joint-stock.name: Wuhan Iron and Steel (joint-stock)
wuhan-iron-and-steel-joint-stock.description: Wuhan Iron and Steel Company Limited, known as WISCO, is a subsidiary of Baoshan Iron and Steel. It was formerly a subsidiary of the state-owned Wuhan Iron and Steel Corporation until 2016 and operates a steel plant in Qingshan District, Wuhan.

winmark.name: Winmark
winmark.description: Winmark Corporation is an American franchisor of five retail businesses specializing in buying and selling used goods. Based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, it transitioned from owning stores to having franchisees own all stores after restructuring in the early 2000s.

watches-of-switzerland.name: Watches of Switzerland
watches-of-switzerland.description: Watches of Switzerland is a British watch retailer headquartered in Braunstone, England. It is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

west-pharmaceutical-services-united-stat.name: West Pharmaceutical Services (United States)
west-pharmaceutical-services-united-stat.description: West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. designs and manufactures injectable pharmaceutical packaging and delivery systems. Founded in 1923 and based in Exton, Pennsylvania, it initially produced rubber components for sterile packaging of drugs like penicillin and insulin.

wangsu-science-technology.name: Wangsu Science & Technology
wangsu-science-technology.description: Wangsu Science & Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company providing content delivery network and Internet data center services. Founded in 2000, it was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2009.

wwe.name: WWE
wwe.description: World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) is an American professional wrestling promotion and the largest wrestling promotion worldwide. It has expanded into film, football, and other ventures, including licensing its intellectual property for video games and action figures. WWE is owned by TKO Group Holdings, a subsidiary of WME Group.

wayfair.name: Wayfair
wayfair.description: Wayfair Inc. is an American multinational e-commerce company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It sells furniture and home goods online and offers millions of items from thousands of global suppliers. The company operates internationally including in North America, Canada, Ireland, China, and the UK.

weichai-power.name: Weichai Power
weichai-power.description: Weichai Power Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company based in Weifang, Shandong. It develops and manufactures diesel engines, forklifts, and non-diesel engine automotive parts. The company operates in the automotive industry.

worley.name: Worley
worley.description: Worley Limited is an Australian engineering and professional services company. It provides consulting and project delivery expertise to the energy, chemicals, resources sectors, and complex process industries.

wockhardt.name: Wockhardt
wockhardt.description: Wockhardt Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical and biotechnology company headquartered in Mumbai. It produces formulations, biopharmaceuticals, nutrition products, vaccines, and active pharmaceutical ingredients. The company has manufacturing plants and subsidiaries in multiple countries including India, the UK, Ireland, France, and the US.

wuling-motors.name: Wuling Motors
wuling-motors.description: Wuling Motor Holdings, Ltd. is a Chinese automobile manufacturer and subsidiary of Guangxi Automotive Group. It produces engines, mini electric cars, people movers, trucks, buses, and auto parts. The Wuling brand is shared with the SAIC-GM-Wuling joint venture.

wilhelmina-models.name: Wilhelmina Models
wilhelmina-models.description: Wilhelmina International Inc., formerly Wilhelmina Models, is a modeling and talent agency headquartered in New York City with offices in Los Angeles, Miami, and London. Founded in 1967, it represents models, entertainers, artists, musicians, and athletes and became the first publicly traded modeling agency in 2009.

wharf-real-estate-investment-company-lim.name: Wharf Real Estate Investment Company Limited
wharf-real-estate-investment-company-lim.legal_name: Wharf Real Estate Investment Company Limited
wharf-real-estate-investment-company-lim.description: Wharf Real Estate Investment Company Limited is a listed real estate portfolio company in China. It is a subsidiary of the private company Wheelock & Co. and a sister company to The Wharf (Holdings), another listed entity.

listings.name: Wharf Real Estate Investment Company Limited

woori-financial-group.name: Woori Financial Group
woori-financial-group.description: Woori Financial Group is a Seoul-based banking and financial services holding company. It is recognized as the largest bank in South Korea.

woori-bank-of-indonesia.name: Woori Bank of Indonesia
woori-bank-of-indonesia.description: Bank Woori Saudara is an Indonesian financial institution founded in 1906 by merchants in Bandung, West Java. It provides banking products such as savings and checking accounts, fixed deposits, and credit loans. The bank serves customers across Indonesia.

weathernews.name: Weathernews
weathernews.description: Weathernews Inc. is a Japanese weather forecasting company headquartered in Mihama Ward, Chiba City. It operates Weathernews LiVE, a 24/7 online live stream, and claims to be the largest privately owned weather company in the world as of 2024.

w-r-grace-and-company.name: W. R. Grace and Company
w-r-grace-and-company.description: W. R. Grace and Company is an American chemical business based in Columbia, Maryland. It produces specialty chemicals and materials through its Performance Catalyst Solutions and Material Technologies divisions.

wacker-chemie-ag.name: Wacker Chemie AG
wacker-chemie-ag.description: Wacker Chemie AG is a German multinational chemical company founded in 1914 by Alexander Wacker. The Wacker family controls more than 50 percent of the shares. The company operates over 25 production sites across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

wendy-s.name: Wendy's
wendy-s.description: Wendy's International, LLC is an American international fast food restaurant chain founded in 1969 in Columbus, Ohio. Its headquarters moved to Dublin, Ohio in 2006. In 2008, it merged with Triarc, the parent company of Arby's, and it is one of the world's largest hamburger fast-food chains.

wheels-up.name: Wheels Up
wheels-up.description: Wheels Up is a private aviation provider based in the United States. Founded in 2013 by Kenny Dichter, it operates using a membership and on-demand business model. Members can book private aircraft from the company fleet and third-party operators via a mobile app.

warsaw-stock-exchange.name: Warsaw Stock Exchange
warsaw-stock-exchange.description: The Warsaw Stock Exchange (WSE) is a stock exchange located in Warsaw, Poland. Founded in 1817, it is the largest stock exchange in Central and Eastern Europe. It hosts over 400 companies and operates several important stock market indices including WIG20 and WIG30.

woolworths-group.name: Woolworths Group
woolworths-group.description: Woolworths Group Limited is an Australian multinational retail and financial services company headquartered in Bella Vista, New South Wales. It operates primarily in retail and financial services sectors.

wabco-vehicle-control-systems.name: WABCO Vehicle Control Systems
wabco-vehicle-control-systems.description: WABCO Holdings, Inc. was a U.S.-based provider of electronic braking, stability, suspension, and transmission automation systems for heavy-duty commercial vehicles. It was spun off in 2007 and acquired by ZF Friedrichshafen in May 2020.

workpoint-entertainment.name: Workpoint Entertainment
workpoint-entertainment.description: Workpoint Entertainment Public Company Limited is a Thai media company founded in 1989. It operates in television production, filmmaking, event management, animation, publishing, event marketing, and recording. The company went public on the Stock Exchange of Thailand in 2004 and has produced numerous television programs across various genres.

waste-connections-of-canada.name: Waste Connections of Canada
waste-connections-of-canada.description: Waste Connections of Canada Inc., formerly Progressive Waste Solutions, is a waste collection company providing non-hazardous solid waste collection, recycling, composting, renewable energy, and landfill disposal services. It is based in Toronto, Canada, with U.S. headquarters in The Woodlands, Texas.

wabco-holdings-inc.name: WABCO Holdings, Inc.
wabco-holdings-inc.description: WABCO Holdings, Inc. was a U.S.-based provider of electronic braking, stability, suspension, and transmission automation systems for heavy-duty commercial vehicles. It was acquired by ZF Friedrichshafen in May 2020.

wesco-international.name: WESCO International
wesco-international.description: Wesco International, Inc. is a publicly traded American holding company for Wesco Distribution. It is an electrical distribution and services company based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

wns-global-services.name: WNS Global Services
wns-global-services.description: WNS (Holdings) Limited is a global business process management company and a subsidiary of Capgemini. It operates in finance and accounting, customer service, procurement, and data analytics. The company is headquartered in New York, London, and Mumbai.

wow.name: WOW!
wow.description: WideOpenWest, Inc. is the eighth largest cable operator in the United States, with a network passing 1.9 million homes and businesses. The company offers landline telephone, broadband Internet services, and cable television.

wpcs-international.name: WPCS International
wpcs-international.description: WPCS International Incorporated is an American design-build engineering firm headquartered in Exton, Pennsylvania. It focuses on wireless network deployment and related services including site design, technology integration, electrical contracting, construction, and maintenance. WPCS serves sectors such as public services, healthcare, alternative energy, and commercial wireless carriers.

waddell-reed.name: Waddell & Reed
waddell-reed.description: Waddell & Reed Financial, Inc. was an American asset management and financial planning company founded in 1937 in Kansas City, Missouri. It operated asset management and distribution subsidiaries including Ivy Investment Management Company and Waddell & Reed Investment Management Company. The company was publicly traded from 1998 to 2021.

want-want-china.name: Want Want China
want-want-china.description: Want Want China Holdings Ltd. is a Chinese company that manufactures, distributes, and sells snacks, beverages, and other products. It is one of the largest rice cracker and flavored drink manufacturers in the world. The company is a subsidiary of Want Want Holdings Limited.

warby-parker.name: Warby Parker
warby-parker.description: Warby Parker Inc. is an American eyewear brand and retailer headquartered in New York City. It sells prescription glasses, contact lenses, and sunglasses, and also offers eye exams. The company was founded in 2010 as an online-only retailer but now generates most revenue from physical stores.

warnaco-group.name: Warnaco Group
warnaco-group.description: The Warnaco Group, Inc. was an American textile and clothing corporation that designed, sourced, marketed, licensed, and distributed underwear, sportswear, and swimwear worldwide. Its products were sold under brand names including Calvin Klein, Speedo, Chaps, Warner's, and Olga.

wafd-bank.name: WaFd Bank
wafd-bank.description: WaFd Bank is a regional bank headquartered in Seattle, Washington, USA. It operates 210 branches across several states including Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Nevada, Utah, Arizona, New Mexico, California, and Texas. It is listed among the largest banks in the United States.

washington-h-soul-pattinson.name: Washington H. Soul Pattinson
washington-h-soul-pattinson.description: Washington H. Soul Pattinson and Company Limited, trading as Soul Patts, is an Australian investment company. It originated from pharmacy operations and has evolved into a diversified investment company with a portfolio across various asset classes.

watsco.name: Watsco
watsco.description: Watsco, Inc. is a US-based distributor of air conditioning, heating, and refrigeration equipment and related parts and supplies. Founded over 60 years ago as a manufacturer in the HVAC/R industry, it shifted to distribution in 1989 by acquiring Gemaire Distributors Inc., a Rheem distributor in South Florida.

webjet-limited.name: Webjet Limited
webjet-limited.description: Webjet is an Australian online travel agency established in 1998 by former Jetset Travel executives. It allows users to book airline tickets and hotel reservations and is currently owned by Webjet Group after a 2024 demerger.

webster-bank.name: Webster Bank
webster-bank.description: Webster Bank is an American commercial bank based in Stamford, Connecticut. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of Santander Bank, N.A. since 2026, with branches and ATMs across several northeastern states.

weis-markets.name: Weis Markets
weis-markets.description: Weis Markets, Inc. is an American food retailer headquartered in Sunbury, Pennsylvania. It operates 200 stores with over 23,000 employees across multiple states including Pennsylvania, Maryland, and New York.

wellcare.name: WellCare
wellcare.description: WellCare Health Plans, Inc. is an American health insurance company providing managed care services primarily through Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and Medicare Prescription Drug plans across the United States.

wesbanco.name: WesBanco
wesbanco.description: WesBanco, Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Wheeling, West Virginia. It operates over 200 branches in West Virginia, Ohio, Western Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Maryland, and Southern Indiana.

west-marine.name: West Marine
west-marine.description: West Marine is an American company based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, operating a chain of boating supply and fishing retail stores. It has 247 stores in North America and runs Blue Future, a nonprofit organization.

westell-technologies-inc.name: Westell Technologies, Inc.
westell-technologies-inc.description: Westell Technologies, Inc. is an Aurora, Illinois company providing telecommunications equipment for wireless and site management solutions. It was the last U.S. manufacturer of DSL modems before announcing plans to outsource manufacturing in 2007.

western-refining.name: Western Refining
western-refining.description: Western Refining, Inc. is a Texas-based crude oil refiner and marketer operating mainly in the Southwestern, North-Central, and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States. It is the fourth largest publicly traded independent refiner and marketer in the nation and has been listed on the New York Stock Exchange since 2006.

westport-fuel-systems.name: Westport Fuel Systems
westport-fuel-systems.description: Westport Fuel Systems Inc. is a Canadian company that develops alternative fuel and low-emissions technologies. It enables engines to operate on clean-burning fuels such as compressed natural gas, liquefied natural gas, hydrogen, and biofuels like landfill gas.

widmer-brothers-brewery.name: Widmer Brothers Brewery
widmer-brothers-brewery.description: Widmer Brothers is a brewery founded in 1984 in Portland, Oregon, by brothers Kurt and Robert Widmer. It is part of the Craft Brew Alliance, which was the 12th largest brewing company in the United States in 2017.

willamette-valley-vineyards.name: Willamette Valley Vineyards
willamette-valley-vineyards.description: Willamette Valley Vineyards is an American winery located in Turner, Oregon, named after the Willamette Valley. It is the leading producer of Willamette Valley-appellated Pinot Noir and was the largest producer of Riesling wine in the Willamette Valley in 2016.

wilson-sons.name: Wilson, Sons
wilson-sons.description: Wilson Sons is a Brazilian shipping company headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. Founded in 1837 by two Scottish brothers, it is one of the oldest private enterprises in Brazil and was later managed by Edward Pellew Wilson Jr.

wing-tai-properties-limited.name: Wing Tai Properties Limited
wing-tai-properties-limited.description: Wing Tai Properties Limited is a Hong Kong-based property developer and hospitality operator. Founded in 1991 and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, it owns tailoring factories and operates hotels under the WingTai Asia and Lanson Place brands.

wingstop.name: Wingstop
wingstop.description: Wingstop Inc. is an American international fast food chain that primarily sells Buffalo wings. It operates in the restaurant industry.

winnebago-industries.name: Winnebago Industries
winnebago-industries.description: Winnebago Industries, Inc. is an American manufacturer of motorhomes and recreational vehicles. The company expanded into motorboat manufacturing in 2018 by acquiring Chris-Craft Corporation. It has also produced light-to-medium utility vehicles and other products.

wisdomtree-investments.name: WisdomTree Investments
wisdomtree-investments.description: WisdomTree, Inc. is a global asset manager and sponsor of exchange-traded funds (ETFs) headquartered in New York. It launched its first ETFs in 2006 and offers products across various asset classes and countries worldwide. WisdomTree is a major ETF provider in the United States.

wolverine-world-wide.name: Wolverine World Wide
wolverine-world-wide.description: Wolverine World Wide, Inc. is an American footwear manufacturer headquartered in Rockford, Michigan. It produces footwear under its own brands like Wolverine Boots and Shoes, Hush Puppies, Chaco, and Merrell, as well as licensed footwear for other companies.

woodward.name: Woodward
woodward.description: Woodward, Inc. is a designer, manufacturer, and service provider of control systems for aircraft, engines, turbines, power generation, and industrial equipment. The company is based in Fort Collins, Colorado and also supplies military and defense equipment.

woolworths.name: Woolworths
woolworths.description: Woolworths is a South African multinational retail company headquartered in Cape Town. Founded in 1931, it owns the Woolworths department store and grocery chain, the Australian retailer Country Road, and South Africa's largest pet store chain, Absolute Pets.

wright-express.name: Wright Express
wright-express.description: WEX Inc. provides payment processing and information management services to the commercial and government vehicle fleet industry. Headquartered in Portland, Maine, it operates in the United States, Canada, South America, Europe, Asia, and Australia.

wuxi-apptec.name: WuXi AppTec
wuxi-apptec.description: WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company providing contract research, development, and manufacturing services for the pharmaceutical and life-sciences industry. It is headquartered in Shanghai and operates facilities in Asia, North America, and Europe.

williams-companies.name: Williams Companies
williams-companies.description: The Williams Companies, Inc. is an American energy company based in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Its core business includes natural gas processing and transportation, along with petroleum and electricity generation assets. It is a Fortune 500 company and part of the S&P 500 index.

wawel.name: Wawel
wawel.description: Wawel is a Polish confectionery company producing chocolates, wafers, chocolate bars, and snacks. It is a well-recognized candy brand in Poland.

wilh-wilhelmsen.name: Wilh. Wilhelmsen
wilh-wilhelmsen.description: Wilh. Wilhelmsen Holding ASA is a Norwegian multinational maritime group headquartered in Lysaker, Norway. It employs over 21,000 people and operates in 75 countries. The group runs the largest maritime network in the world with more than 2200 locations globally.

wizz-air.name: Wizz Air
wizz-air.hq: Budapest Ferenc Liszt International Airport, Hungary
wizz-air.description: Wizz Air Holdings plc is a Hungarian ultra-low-cost airline group headquartered in Budapest, Hungary. Founded in 2003, it operates an exclusive Airbus fleet and is the world's largest operator of the Airbus A321neo aircraft. The airline serves numerous cities across Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East.

wielton.name: Wielton
wielton.description: Wielton SA is a Polish manufacturer specializing in tippers and tautliners for traction units. It is the third largest producer of semi-trailers in Europe and leads the market in several Central- and Eastern European countries as well as Central Asia.

wom.name: WOM
wom.description: WOM S.A. is a Chilean telecommunications company providing mobile telephony, Internet service, television service, and media streaming. It operates primarily in Chile's telecommunications market.

westair-aviation.name: Westair Aviation
westair-aviation.description: Westair Aviation Limited is a Namibian aviation service provider and airline based at Eros Airport in Windhoek. It offers scheduled passenger services under the FlyNamibia brand, as well as cargo and ACMI services.

westjet.name: WestJet
westjet.description: WestJet is a Canadian airline headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. Founded in 1994, it is the second-largest airline in Canada and the eighth largest in North America by frequency, initially launched as a low-cost alternative with three aircraft and five destinations.

whistler-blackcomb.name: Whistler Blackcomb
whistler-blackcomb.description: Whistler Blackcomb is a ski resort located in Whistler, British Columbia, Canada. It is the largest ski resort in North America by several measures and features the Peak 2 Peak Gondola connecting two mountains.

western-forest-products.name: Western Forest Products
western-forest-products.description: Western Forest Products Inc. is a Canadian lumber company based in Vancouver, British Columbia. It operates in the industrial sector focusing on lumber production.

weatherford-international.name: Weatherford International
weatherford-international.description: Weatherford International plc is an American multinational oilfield service company headquartered in the US. It operates in 75 countries providing technical equipment and services for drilling, evaluation, completion, production, and intervention on oil and gas wells.

west-coast-bancorp.name: West Coast Bancorp
west-coast-bancorp.description: West Coast Bancorp was a publicly traded financial services holding company based in Lake Oswego, Oregon. Its main holding was West Coast Bank with 63 branches in Oregon and Washington before being acquired by Columbia Banking System in 2012.

westshore-terminals.name: Westshore Terminals
westshore-terminals.description: Westshore Terminals is a tenant at Roberts Bank, a twin-terminal port facility located in Delta, British Columbia, Canada. The port opened in 1970 with Westshore Terminals as its only tenant and expanded with a second terminal in 1997.

wolfson-microelectronics.name: Wolfson Microelectronics
wolfson-microelectronics.description: Wolfson Microelectronics plc was a microelectronics and fabless semiconductor company based in Edinburgh, Scotland. It specialized in signal processing and mixed-signal chips for consumer electronics. The company was acquired by Cirrus Logic in 2014.

workspace-group.name: Workspace Group
workspace-group.description: Workspace Group plc is a real estate investment trust based in London, England. Founded in 1987, it leases office, industrial, and workshop spaces to small and medium-sized enterprises. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

wafa-assurance.name: Wafa Assurance
wafa-assurance.description: Wafa Assurance is a Moroccan insurance company and subsidiary of Attijariwafa Bank. Founded in 1972 and headquartered in Casablanca, it offers life and non-life insurance services to individual and corporate clients and is part of the Al Mada holding group.

wakaliwood.name: Wakaliwood
wakaliwood.description: Wakaliwood, also known as Ramon Film Productions, is a film studio located in Wakaliga, a slum in Kampala, Uganda. It is known for producing ultra-low budget action movies, including titles like Who Killed Captain Alex? and Bad Black.

wet-n-wild.name: Wet 'n Wild
wet-n-wild.description: Wet ‘n Wild is a name used by various water parks operating in the United States, Brazil, and formerly Mexico. These parks were part of a water park chain originally owned by George Millay, the creator of SeaWorld. The brand is distinct from other similarly named water parks owned by different companies.

wimpy.name: Wimpy
wimpy.description: Wimpy is a British fast-food casual dining chain that was founded in the United States. It found its success mainly in South Africa and has alternated between table-service and counter-service formats throughout its history.

werthein-group.name: Werthein Group
werthein-group.description: Grupo Werthein is a holding company founded in 1928 and based in Argentina. It has been led by members of the Werthein family since its origins. The company operates in the investment sector.

wingo.name: Wingo
wingo.description: AeroRepública, S. A., trading as Wingo, is a low-cost airline owned by Copa Holdings. It was created in 2016 to replace most of Copa Airlines Colombia's business. The company appointed Carolina Cortizo as managing director in 2019.

wallyscar.name: Wallyscar
wallyscar.description: Wallyscar is a Tunisian car manufacturer founded in 2006 and based in Ben Arous. The company produces about 600 vehicles per year, selling mainly in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East. It collaborates with Peugeot and uses PSA engines in its cars.

willowvale-motor-industries.name: Willowvale Motor Industries
willowvale-motor-industries.description: Willowvale Motor Industries (Pvt.) Ltd. is an automobile and commercial vehicle manufacturer based in Zimbabwe. It operates within the automotive industry.

wilderness-air.name: Wilderness Air
wilderness-air.description: Wilderness Air, formerly Sefofane Air Charter, is an air charter company headquartered in Botswana. It operates scheduled and charter flights, cargo operations, and runs a charity called Children in the Wilderness. It also operates Botswana's first flight simulator for pilot training.

waltair.name: Waltair
waltair.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
waltair.description: Waltair was an airline operating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from 1983 to 2005. It was known for using the Sud Caravelle aircraft. Its operating certificate was revoked in 2005 and it was banned by the European Union.
